description: Fetch user reviews for an app. Supports filtering by star rating range and sorting by recent or helpful. Useful for sentiment analysis, feature-request mining, and competitive research. If the store is throttling, the result may be Sonar's stored copy: it then comes back as `{ data, meta }` with `meta.stale: true`, its date in `meta.stale_as_of`, and a `meta.note` to pass on to the user.

country.description: Market as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "us", "gb", "de", "mt"). Any App Store storefront (175 countries) or Google Play market (145). Default "us".

lang.description: Android only: fetch one language feed (e.g. ar, fr). Omit to merge the market language plus en, es, fr, ar; coverage is not exhaustive.

limit.description: Maximum number of reviews to return (1-200).

max_rating.description: Filter to reviews with a star rating <= this value (1-5).

min_rating.description: Filter to reviews with a star rating >= this value (1-5).

sort.description: Sort order. "recent" returns newest first, "helpful" returns most-voted first.

store.description: App store. "ios" for Apple App Store, "android" for Google Play.

store_id.description: Store-specific app identifier. iOS: numeric track ID. Android: package name.

name: sonar_app_reviews
title: Fetch App Reviews
